title: Cully Hamner
description:
A star pilot-in-training misadventure on Tatooine titled, "Stone Needle Pilots". "The only place that I'm aware of this scene appearing is in the STAR WARS radio drama," recalls Cully Hamner. "I think it's indicative oi not only Luke's youth and foolhardiness, but his strength in the Force." Hamner began working with DC Comics back in '91 (GREEN LANTERN: MOSAIC). Soon after he started rendering covers, pin-ups and trading cards for Image and Dark Horse. Currently, Hamner pencils FIREARM for Malibu's Ultraverse and is plotting and penciling a feature called "Brave," with Gerard Jones, for Gaijin Studio's GROUND ZERO.

ART: Dave Johnson
